settings.sessionLanguage.body: The language sessions write to you in: their questions, closing notes, decline reasons and last words. Code, commands and anything quoted stay as written. A repository's own wins over its workspace's; unset, sessions are asked for none. The window's own language is in Appearance, and neither sets the other.
settings.sessionLanguage.from.none: None: its sessions are asked for no language.
settings.sessionLanguage.saved: Sessions in {{name}} write to you in {{language}} now. A session already running keeps what it was handed.
settings.sessionLanguage.cleared: {{name}} sets no session language of its own now.
